kultivator.sectbuild.bahan_tip.tanah: Fill and soil, mostly paid by what the builders dig. Dirt, grass, podzol, mud, sand, gravel, soul sand: 1 each.
kultivator.sectbuild.bahan_tip.kayu: Beams, frames, doors, lattice. A log is worth 4, planks 1, a bamboo block 2.
kultivator.sectbuild.bahan_tip.genteng: Roof tiles, ridges, interior floors. Deepslate and blackstone families, clay, bricks, terracotta, mud bricks.
kultivator.sectbuild.bahan_tip.kapur: Plaster and marble. Calcite, diorite, quartz, white concrete, bone blocks, snow blocks.
kultivator.sectbuild.bahan_tip.pernis: Lacquered pillars, palace walls, glaze. Cinnabar, any dye, beetroot, red/yellow/blue concrete, red terracotta or wool.
kultivator.sectbuild.bahan_tip.flora: Trees, beds, hedges, lotus. Saplings, flowers (tall ones 2), lily pads, moss, azaleas, dripleaf, leaves 1/4.
kultivator.sectbuild.bahan_tip.logam: Chains, lights, fittings. Iron, chains, lanterns, glowstone, shroomlights, froglights, sea lanterns, candles.
kultivator.sectbuild.bahan_tip.permata: Gilt, jade trims and lattice, the Jade and Sky glazes. Gold, copper, prismarine, emerald, lapis, diamond, sulfur.

kultivator.screen.help.bangun.title: Sect Construction
kultivator.screen.help.bangun: Choose one of nine sect templates on the Build tablet of your Sect Hall (or in chat), preview its footprint as a hologram, rotate it and confirm. From then on you only deposit materials: sneak and right-click the stele with stone, timber, tiles and the rest, or use the tablet's deposit buttons. Each building starts by itself as soon as its materials are complete and rises at a pace you can watch, through nine tiers that each already look finished. Builders (up to four disciples), tier missions, daily offers and gathering trips only make it faster. Blocks are placed only inside the footprint you confirmed; natural ground and plants moved there are credited to the Storehouse, and your own buildings are never removed silently. Breaking a sect block or an explosion returns its materials, and Inspect & repair refills holes. Construction runs while you (or a sect mate) are within reach of the stele; in singleplayer, alt-tabbing pauses the game, so nothing builds and nothing is banked. Sources: Return of the Mount Hua Sect (the fallen Mount Hua restored), Perfect World ch. 551/558 (Shi Hao vows to rebuild the Heaven Mending Pavilion), Martial Peak (High Heaven Palace), Battle Through the Heavens (Pan Men, Xiao Gate); the Storehouse follows Yue Lu Hall, A Record of a Mortal's Journey ch. 153.
